name: Browser
description: A headless Chromium that opens and reads web pages on the domains you allow. Reading is automatic until the Run has seen untrusted content; clicking and typing always ask you first.

tools.name: open_page
tools.description: Open a page on an allowed domain and read its text (the address reaches the site: asks you once the Run is tainted)

tools.name: get_text
tools.description: Read the text of the current page or part of it

tools.name: list_links
tools.description: List the links on the current page

tools.name: click
tools.description: Click an element (may submit a form: asks you)

tools.name: fill
tools.description: Type into a form field (asks you)

settings.name: BROWSER_ALLOWED_DOMAINS
settings.description: Domains the browser may reach, comma-separated: 'example.com' is that host only, '*.example.com' its subdomains. IP addresses only when listed exactly. Every request a page makes is checked.

settings.name: BROWSER_EXECUTABLE
settings.description: Optional path to a Chromium binary (default: Playwright's Chromium, see PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH).

settings.name: BROWSER_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ADDRESSES
settings.description: Set to 'true' to let allowed names resolve to private, loopback or link-local addresses (an intranet site). Off by default: such answers are refused; cloud metadata addresses are refused even then. An IP address you list exactly is always reachable.
